runbook: R-18 / R-19 (independent oracle, blind to diff/plan/src/tests/scripts)

evidence_tree.built_with: git archive --format=tar HEAD data docs/math-foundations.md | tar -x -C <scratch>

sources_quoted.quote: Enemy champions within {{tt|700 units|center to edge}} of you become cursed, causing them to receive {{as|12% increased magic damage|magic damage}} from all sources.

{{tip|Immobilize|Immobilizing}} an enemy champion marks them as ''Vulnerable'' for 4 seconds, increasing the damage they take from all sources by 7%. Subsequent immobilizes against a target extend the duration of the effect.

sources_quoted.note: Decomposed atom independently pins the same 700-unit radius and 12 percent magic-damage figure.

sources_quoted.quote: f(S) = the coupled participant-timeline score: deterministic total damage dealt by the main participant ... Each evaluation is a full coupled fight simulation
sources_quoted.note: Establishes that a 'coupled' scenario is a shared-timeline multi-participant fight, i.e. target-side debuffs are shared state across the roster, not attacker-local state.

step_1_observed_ratio.rounding_band: goldens are carried to 0.1, so the true ratio lies in [469.45/419.25, 469.55/419.15] = [1.119738, 1.120243]
step_1_observed_ratio.conclusion: The band contains 1.12 and no other simple amplifier value. The change is exactly one multiplicative factor of 1.12.

candidates_in_this_scenario: Abyssal Mask 'Unmake' curse: x1.12 on magic damage from all sources (S1, S2, S4)
Imperial Mandate 'Command' Vulnerable: x1.07 on all damage from all sources (S3)
step_2_identify_the_factor.match: 1.12 == Abyssal Mask Unmake exactly. No combination of the 7 percent Vulnerable factor reproduces the observed ratio: 1.19/1.07 = 1.1121 (additive-stacking hypothesis), 1.07*1.12/1.07 = 1.12 (multiplicative-stacking hypothesis). Only the multiplicative hypothesis lands inside the rounding band.

step_3_reconstruct_the_pre_amp_damage.assumption: the old leaf already carried the Mandate Vulnerable factor (a target-side debuff the old engine did apply)
step_3_reconstruct_the_pre_amp_damage.B_pre_amp: 419.2 / 1.07 = 391.776 post-mitigation magic damage before target-side amplification
step_3_reconstruct_the_pre_amp_damage.note: The reconstruction is scale-free: whether the old value was B or B*1.07, inserting the single missing x1.12 curse factor yields 419.2 * 1.12 = 469.504 -> 469.5, matching the new golden to the last carried digit.

step_4_rule_from_the_wiki_text.rule: Unmake is a debuff placed on the ENEMY champion ('Enemy champions ... become cursed, causing them to receive 12% increased magic damage FROM ALL SOURCES'), not a buff on the item holder.
step_4_rule_from_the_wiki_text.consequence: In a coupled roster fight, once the cursed target is inside the 700-unit radius of the Abyssal Mask carrier, every roster member's magic damage against that target is amplified by 12 percent, including participants who do not own the item. The same 'from all sources' construction governs Imperial Mandate's Vulnerable (S3), which the engine already honoured.
step_4_rule_from_the_wiki_text.therefore: A non-carrier participant's magic-damage row (breakdown[1]) that lacked the x1.12 factor was undercounting by exactly the curse. 469.5 is the value the cached wiki text requires; 419.2 omitted the ally-sourced curse.

step_5_stacking_form.claim: The two 'increased damage taken' debuffs are independent target-side amplifiers and compose multiplicatively: 1.07 * 1.12 = 1.1984.
step_5_stacking_form.support: Each item states its own independent 'increased damage they take' / 'increased magic damage' clause with no shared-bucket or unique-stacking language (S1, S3); the goldens are consistent with the multiplicative composition and inconsistent with an additive 1.19 bucket (step_2.ruled_out).

residual_uncertainty.statement: The scenario definition lives outside the permitted evidence tree (scripts/, tests/), so the damage type of breakdown[1]/sources[2] could not be read directly.
residual_uncertainty.falsifier: If sources[2] were physical or true damage, the x1.12 curse must NOT apply (Unmake is explicitly magic-damage-only per S1/S2/S4) and 419.2 would be the correct value.
residual_uncertainty.why_the_verdict_still_stands: The observed delta is exactly one Abyssal curse factor applied to a non-carrier participant's row in a scenario named for that very interaction ('mandate_abyssal_curse_roster'); under the wiki's explicit 'from all sources' wording that is the correct direction of change. The competing reading requires the engine to have newly applied a magic-only amplifier to non-magic damage, which no reading of the cached item text supports.
